issues.title: Clarify a policy record's verification date
issues.body:
### Affected page or record
Policy record: example-policy

### Feedback type
Data correction

### What did you observe
The verification note may predate the cited publication. Contact researcher@example.com or +1 (202) 555-0199.

### Proposed improvement
Check the official publication and update only the evidence-backed date.

### Evidence URL
https://example.gov.pk/official-record

### Accessibility context
_No response_

issues.title: Improve focus visibility in the source dialog
issues.body:
### Affected page or record
Source detail dialog

### Feedback type
Accessibility

### What did you observe
The return focus is difficult to locate after closing the dialog.

### Proposed improvement
Restore focus to the source card and add a regression test.

### Evidence URL
https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-visible.html

### Accessibility context
Keyboard-only navigation at 200% zoom.
